title: How Batteries Evolved 🔋 From Salty Discs to Lithium-Ion #shorts #engineering
description:
The first battery was a stack of metal discs and salty cloth. From Volta's pile in 1800 to Planté's rechargeable lead-acid battery, the dry cell and the flashlight, alkaline cells, and the lithium-ion battery that powers phones and electric cars. Follow for more How It Evolved!
